meta.title: Desktop Copilot
meta.description: Drives the real Windows desktop one confirmed step at a time: screenshot plus UI Automation targets, a 3-way card, and a stop hotkey.

tools.desktop_capture: Capture the front window and its elements.
tools.desktop_step: Propose up to 3 actions and act on the user's choice.
tools.desktop_control: Status, stop, or the automatic switch.
